cells.tense: You see what sits underneath a thing, and it arrives whole, without work.
cells.ask: Let one pattern you have been sitting with go out to someone who would use it. Say it in their words, not yours, and let that be the whole point of telling them.
cells.core:
You see the shape under the surface, and you don't force it. It shows up full, and it doesn't need defending or announcing. You are not checking whether it is yours before you say it, and you are not dressing it up once you have.

Something lands in you and you know how it works before you know why. What you pass on arrives without strain, and it travels — people take it and build on it and the shape keeps holding up under their hands, which is what tells you it was real.

This part is fed and free. The turning happens on its own, and there is nothing here to reach back for.
cells.sheetLine: You see the shape, and it needs no proof from you.
cells.place: in the pattern under the thing

cells.tense: You are already solving the next version of this before anyone finished explaining it.
cells.ask: Pick one thing you are already sure of and leave it alone for a day. Let someone else's reading be the one that lands, and don't correct it when it does.
cells.core:
You keep stepping ahead of where the thing actually is. The pattern in front of you is clear, so you push it out past where it belongs — to the version that hasn't happened, to the explanation nobody asked for yet. The reading didn't stop. It stopped waiting.

When that runs, the light you're carrying becomes the argument you're winning. The attention lands on you instead of the shape, and the shape is the thing worth having. The pressure is real and it's costing you the contact.

There's another way to hold this. The moment you leave unread stays open, and open is where the actual thing shows up. Let one reading be wrong without fixing it.
cells.sheetLine: You see the shape and you push it out of reach.
cells.place: in the pattern under the thing

cells.tense: You stopped letting people see what you can do, years back, and it stuck.
cells.ask: Say the thing you can see to one person this week, out loud, nothing about it tentative. Then let it be theirs to do something with, or nothing with.
cells.core:
You have read something right, and you keep offering it as if it were only tentative. A door is behind you and you are still at it, waiting to be sure of what you saw. The reading didn't go anywhere. You stopped showing it.

It arrives as false modesty, and you can probably point to the moment it turned into that. What is there is real, and dimming it takes effort you'd rather not spend. You don't have to shine at anyone. You only have to stop pretending the reading isn't yours.

You don't have to defend it either. What you see is clear enough on its own to stand without you holding it up.
cells.sheetLine: You are dimming something that is plainly yours.
cells.place: in the pattern under the thing

cells.tense: You are reading the room and how it works right now, and you call that nothing.
cells.ask: At the end of today, write one line naming a pattern you saw in something real and what it turned out to be. Just the line, no verdict on it.
cells.core:
You are already seeing how it works, in real time, and you describe that as just paying attention. The reading happens; the note that it's you who did it doesn't get made. Nothing is hidden. It just doesn't get filed under your name.

The light and the reading are one gesture, and you aren't claiming either. The shape shows up under your hand and you call it the thing's own shape. It isn't. It's yours, and that fact is available to you the moment you look at it.

What's in front of you keeps arriving, and you get to meet it as someone doing the meeting. That's the whole claim, and it's yours to make.
cells.sheetLine: You are already reading it. You just aren't signed on it.
cells.place: in the pattern under the thing

A reader could reasonably say they already do this without thinking, and the cell names the pattern-seeing rather than the radiance, which is the part a person can actually report. The ask survives being wrong about them because letting one understanding travel and land is worth doing even for someone who is not in this seat at all. The sentence that serves me more than them is any line suggesting they get some credit for their own light.
